column1: # heteronyms_curated.tsv — hand-curated canonical readings for high-stakes phrases.
# Semantics: for each phrase listed here, the dict assembly (ROADMAP item 23)
# emits ONLY the canonical (pinyin, phrase) entry; all other reading variants
# from phrases_composed.tsv are suppressed for this phrase.
# Inclusion policy: confidence >90% that the listed reading is canonical
# in standard Mandarin (Putonghua / 普通话). Ambiguous phrases like 朝阳
# (district name zhaoyang vs sun-facing chaoyang) and 长大 (zhangda vs changda)
# are deliberately omitted = both readings retained in dict; v0.3 L0 user-
# This list covers ~80 entries — the high-frequency cases where Unihan's
# inclusion of dialectal / archaic readings produces noise (自己 ziji/ziqi,
# 没有 meiyou + 5 noise variants) plus genuine heteronyms (银行 yinhang,
# 行业 hangye, 都是 doushi).
# Source ranking: top entries from data/heteronyms_candidates.tsv (jieba freq
# desc). Curated by hand using standard Mandarin knowledge.
